Are you ready for a challenging career in the FAB Engineering team? Would you like to work with the most high-tech devices? Then read on quickly!

As an Equipment Maintenance Engineer, you'll start your journey in the esteemed FAB Engineering team:

• You'll get hands-on experience with the high-tech process equipment in our cleanroom. No need to be an expert from day one – we'll give you the time to thoroughly understand these cutting-edge tools. The team takes pride in maintaining and fine-tuning some of the most advanced equipment globally. You'll even get a chance to work with first versions and prototypes, which is pretty exciting!
• You will work closely with equipment manufacturers and other process engineers, so you'll be collaborating with a diverse group of experts.
• You’ll be part of the FAB Engineering team that consists of over 100 talented individuals with whom you will form the beating heart of our research institute. Specializing in nano-electronics, your work will contribute to technological solutions in various fields like healthcare and energy.

• You hold a Master's degree in Industrial Science with a focus on Electromechanics or Mechanics, or you have acquired equivalent technical experience. If you're just starting out, that's perfectly fine! We welcome motivated beginners who are eager to launch their careers.
• You are genuinely passionate about technology and equipment, and you are not afraid to work hands-on. Your technical knowledge of pneumatics, pumps, motors, electronics, and (electro)mechanics is a valuable asset.
• We highly appreciate your collaborative spirit, while also trusting your ability to proactively plan and organize your work on your own.
• You have a very good knowledge of English.
You will work in a shift regime: early - late (6u-14u & 14u-22u) and 1 weekend every 3 weeks

For a growing technical organization in the logistics sector, we are looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician who wants to contribute to the reliability and efficiency of industrial installations. As a Maintenance Technician, under the supervision of a supervisor, you will be responsible for the proper functioning of automated sorting systems and conveyor lines. 

Your responsibilities include: 

 
• Carrying out preventive maintenance according to the CMMS plan (Computerized Maintenance Management System). 
 
•  
Quickly and efficiently detecting and resolving technical faults. 

 
•  
Making technical improvement proposals based on your experience with breakdowns. 

 
• Advising your supervisor on technical optimizations. 
 
•  
Preparing intervention reports and correctly registering activities in the CMMS system. 

 
•  
Managing stock and following up on spare parts. 

 
•  
Training and supporting users in carrying out first-line maintenance. 

 
• Providing technical support to the operational teams. 

In the long term, you will also work in the Vilvoorde region.

 
• You hold a technical secondary education (TSO) or Bachelor's degree in electromechanics, industrial electricity, or automation. 
 

 
• You have broad technical knowledge of mechanics, electricity, automation, and pneumatics. 
 

 
• You have experience with industrial IT and CMMS systems. 
 
•  
Knowledge of sorting systems or conveyor systems is a plus. 

 
• You are fluent in English and either French or Dutch.

As a production worker, you will work together with a colleague every day to manufacture safety boots 👢. You will place components such as the steel toe cap, lining and sole into the mould. The machine automatically injects the plastic, after which you remove the finished boot. In between production runs, you clean the machine to ensure it is ready for the next production cycle.

After training, you will also be able to operate other machines. You will cut away larger excess pieces and trim fine seams ✂️. You will carry out quality checks and pay close attention to detail. Every boot must meet strict quality standards. With your keen eye for detail, you make sure that only top-quality products leave the facility.

Working together with your colleagues is important. You step in where needed and support each other in achieving the production targets. You work accurately and take pride in the end result. Are you eager to learn and quality-focused? Then this could be the opportunity for you! ✅

Sound like the job for you? Apply now and discover how you can make a difference!

Who are we looking for?

• You have some initial stable experience in a production environment ⚙️
• You speak English well; Dutch is a plus.
• You have your own means of transportation (public transport is not available).
• You are attentive and have an eye for detail. 👀
• You can work at a fast pace and are physically fit. 💪
• You are not afraid of physically demanding work.

As a CNC operator (wood), you set up CNC machines daily to process wood and monitor the quality of the products. You work with WoodWOP programming software and follow technical drawings. Together with colleagues, you ensure smooth production and carry out small adjustments or maintenance as needed.
Are you an experienced CNC operator in the wood sector and looking for a new job? Be sure to get in touch!

At least 5 years of experience as a CNC operator in the wood sector

Knowledge of WoodWOP software

Ability to read technical drawings
Precise, quality-conscious, and team-oriented

Very good knowledge of English
Able to work independently and flexibly

You produce and assemble kitchens and fixed custom furniture in the workshop in Staden. You deliver high-quality work using both modern machines and traditional tools.
On a typical day:
• You prepare materials
• You assemble parts
• You finish projects with attention to detail
• You keep safety and order in mind
Does this sound like you? Apply right away!

• Technical or vocational training in woodwork

• At least 5 years of experience as a woodworker

• Able to read technical drawings

• Organized and able to work independently

• Team player

• Stress resistant and flexible

• Able to speak Dutch or English

• Experience with furniture assembly and finishing

• Skilled with hand and power tools

For our client located in Ostend, we are looking for a High Voltage Technician. This company specializes in large, high-quality projects in West and East Flanders.

You job as a HIGH VOLTAGE ELECTRICIAN in OOSTENDE:

  • Maintenance and repair of high-voltage installations;
  • Identifying and resolving malfunctions;
  • Correct administrative processing of interventions;
  • Performing inspections and troubleshooting;
  • Testing and commissioning electrical systems;
  • Collaborating with engineers and project teams for innovative solutions.
Our client in Ostend is looking for a new High Voltage Technician with the following qualities:

  • Technical background with experience in medium/high-voltage installations or a strong interest in the field;
  • BA5 certification and strong awareness of safety regulations;
  • You speak DUTCH or GOOD ENGLISH;
  • Eager to learn and motivated to grow into an independent role.

For our client located in WESTENDE we are looking for a ROAD WORKER!

Our client is a well-known contractor who does assignments for the government and private sector.

Do you like to roll up your sleeves and work outdoors? Then you are the person we are looking for!

As a ROAD WORKER in WESTENDE this is your job:

  • You are responsible for sewerage works;
  • You are responsible for placing embroidery;
  • Construction of cycle paths, roads and car parks;
  • Placing environmental pavements;
  • Placing roundabouts and refuges;
  • Placing vowels and paving stones;

As a ROAD WORKER in WESTENDE you can find yourself in the following

  • You speak Englisch or Dutch
  • You are handy and like to work outside
  • No study requirements - motivation is what we need!

For our client, a well-known company in the VEURNE region, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER.

Do you enjoy variety in your job and love renovating? We've got you covered!

Your day as a RENOVATION WORKER in the Veurne region will look like this:

  • Together with your colleagues, you carry out demolition work;
  • You lay ceramic and natural stone tiles;
  • You ensure that masonry and cementing work is carried out correctly;
  • You make sure that stability work is not overlooked;
  • You ensure that the entire renovation is completed with high quality.



As a RENOVATION WORKER in VEURNE, you meet the following requirements:

  • A telehandler certificate is a plus!
  • You have extensive experience as a renovation worker;
  • You have a category B driving license and can easily commute to the company;
  • You speak Dutch or English

For a family-owned company located in Oudenburg, we are looking for a WORKSHOP CARPENTER.

Do you enjoy making and installing windows? We got you!

As a WINDOW INSTALLER in the Oudenburg region, your tasks will include:

  • Manufacturing and installing wooden balustrades and windows;
  • Reading technical plans and measuring the correct dimensions on wooden structures;
  • Operating CNC machines and specific woodworking machines;
  • Producing window frames;
  • Responsible for the installation of carpentry work;
  • Making and installing custom-made windows and doors (aluminium, PVC, wood, etc.).
As a WINDOW INSTALLER in Oudenburg, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • You have experience as a carpenter;
  • You speak Dutch or English
  • Physical work does not scare you!

For our client in the KOEKELARE region, we are looking for a BRICKLAYER.

Our client is a family-owned construction company with 30 years of experience. They specialize in new builds and structural work for apartments and houses, mainly for real estate agencies and larger projects.

Your tasks as a BRICKLAYER in KOEKELARE:

  • Carrying out bricklaying work;
  • Performing masonry and formwork tasks;
  • Building interior and exterior walls in fast construction, façade, and visible brickwork;
  • Setting out brickwork according to plans and checking levels;
  • Pointing and finishing walls.
This is you as a BRICKLAYER in KOEKELARE:

  • Some experience as a bricklayer;
  • Good command of Dutch or English;
  • Driving license B is a plus, but not required if you can get to the site independently;
  • Enjoy working in a team and have a strong work ethic.

For our client, we are looking for a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE.
The company specializes in both small and large renovation projects throughout West Flanders. They handle full A-to-Z renovations as well as smaller works such as bathroom renovations, mainly for private clients, with occasional assignments for companies and organizations.

As a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE, your tasks include:

  • Assisting with paving, small renovations, and indoor works
  • Preparing renovation works (measuring, basic demolition, preparing materials)
  • Installing plasterboard (gyproc), small masonry tasks, and simple carpentry
  • Assisting with floor and tile installation and basic interior finishing
  • Supporting full renovation projects from A to Z
  • Preparing materials, assisting with installation, finishing, and site cleanup
As a RENOVATION WORKER in MIDDELKERKE, you recognize yourself in the following:

  • You have initial experience as a renovation worker
  • You speak Dutch or English
  • You are not afraid of physical work

For a well-known company with locations in Belgium, Spain, Canada, and France, we are looking for a Chocolatier for the site in Bredene.
